title: jq, read like a tree

specimen.common: jq, the command-line JSON processor, cut at HEAD
specimen.note: Wide early rings from 2012 to 2015, then a long band of hairline rings: after jq 1.6 in late 2018 the trunk barely grows for almost five years, with two quarters of no growth at all. In 2023 the project moves to the jqlang organisation and lays down its widest ring.

events.title: Haskell out, C in
events.note: old Haskell code deleted, build cleaned up

events.title: jq 1.6
events.note: the last release for almost five years

events.title: New home: jqlang
events.note: URLs move from stedolan to jqlang

events.title: Bundled libraries move
events.note: oniguruma and decNumber go to vendor/

epilogue: Fifty-eight quarterly rings. Nicolas Williams and Stephen Dolan carry the inner wood; itchyny, Emanuele Torre and Mattias Wadman arrive with the revival. Thin rings are not a judgement on anyone: they are only how many commits landed.
